verified_scenarios: Admin-only project configuration and no implicit general-HR grants
Two projects on the same day, exactly 24 hours allowed and >24 rejected
Legacy records preserved; legacy/new weekly edits share daily cap when intersecting
Batch validation and transaction rollback across all HR tables
Optimistic versions and immutable submitted/approved/rejected records
Empty existing draft can move hours to another project atomically
Same operation replay returns currently authorized current week; changed payload and cross-user replay rejected
Project approver sees only submitted/approved/rejected assigned project records, including count/limit, queues and pending actions
Private draft and returned edit history omitted from scoped reviewer snapshots
Admin/global read permission does not imply designated approval; self-review denied
Removed designation, disabled project/account and removed hr.view_own take effect immediately on reads, history, queue and receipt replay
Approved project remains unchanged when another project is returned and corrected
Return and reject require nonblank justification
Exact company header and named bearer session required for writes
Concurrent 16-hour saves cannot both commit for the same day
First valid project changes HR1 to HR2 atomically; invalid first project leaves HR1; incomplete HR2 rejected without repair or deletion
Complete and HR-only archives restore configuration, designations, timesheets, history and receipts with integrity_check=ok and fresh login authorization
Operational-only archive physically excludes project/approval/hour markers and resets to empty HR1; source HR snapshot unchanged
Omitted weekly record notes preserve saved content; explicit empty notes clears the current value
limitations: No live company data or production service used
No browser/UI or mobile claims from this suite
No emails or external messages sent
Full application integration/publication remains coordinator responsibility
